note:
Article about the hopelessness americans feel. A choice quote is JP Morgan estimating to recoup the investment in AI at %10 return would require $34.72/month from every current iPhone user until 2030.
Current estimate of world population using iPhones is 1.5B, or about half of the population. Current investment in AI is estimated at $1.5T. Doubling rate of 10% is about 7 years, so, being generious and considering a 5 year doubling (~15%), then this puts it about $3T. $3T/1.5B/(5y*12m/y) ~ $33/month. Taking world population of 8.2B, this yields $3T/8.2B/(5y*12mo/y) ~ $6/mo.
